answers.why: Both — the opening and script show the street façade and clear views into a single modest dining room; it's not a vehicle and the place is one connected dining room.

layout: A single modest modern restaurant: a centred open glazed entrance under a broad signboard and maroon trim, giving a clear line of sight into one connected dining room. The polished stainless-steel food counter with matching maroon trim runs across the back wall and is framed by restrained timber lattice panels and terracotta accents. Honey-toned wooden tables and dark-brown chairs fill the floor in a central bank and a left bank beneath woven cane pendant shades; cream walls and pale floor tiles reflect warm interior lighting mixed with daylight through the entrance.

views.camera: On the pavement, facing the restaurant front at eye level, centered on the entrance.
views.sees: The whole façade: the broad signboard above, the open glazed entrance with maroon-trimmed frame, and through the glass a clear view into the dining room — pendant shades, rows of wooden tables and the stainless-steel counter at the back; near foreground shows the pavement edge.

views.camera: Close outside the open glazed doors, looking directly in through the entrance.
views.sees: The maroon-trimmed doorway filling the frame; the threshold and first row of honey-toned tables and dark-brown chairs immediately beyond; woven cane shades overhead and pale floor tiles leading the eye to the back counter and timber lattice panels.

views.camera: Standing just inside the entrance, a little back from the door, looking deeper into the dining room.
views.sees: The full interior at once: centre and left banks of wooden tables and chairs under woven cane pendant shades, cream walls with terracotta accents, pale tiled floor, and across the far wall the polished stainless-steel food counter with maroon trim framed by timber lattice panels.

views.camera: From inside near the back of the room, turned toward the entrance and the street beyond.
views.sees: The glazed entrance and maroon frame at the centre, daylight spilling in and the pavement visible beyond the doors; a top slice of the broad signboard above is visible through the glass; nearer in the edge of tables and pendant shades sit in the foreground.

views.camera: Close on the food counter, eye-level and square to its finished face.
views.sees: A polished stainless-steel surface with the maroon trim band along its front, the restrained timber lattice paneling directly behind and terracotta accents at the counter edge; no people or equipment shown, just the finished serving face.

views.camera: Close on a table, slightly above table height, square on the tabletop.
views.sees: A honey-toned wooden table surface with the edge of a dark-brown chair, the woven cane pendant shade hanging above and a small terracotta accent (tile or low ledge) in the background, pale floor tiles beneath.
